import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, long cap, long flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class PushRelabel {
        int N;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> G;
        List<Integer> h, inQ, count;
        List<Long> excess;
        Queue<Integer> Q;

        PushRelabel(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            this.edges = new ArrayList<>();
            this.G = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                G.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            this.h = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N, 0));
            this.inQ = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N, 0));
            this.count = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N * 2, 0));
            this.excess = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N, 0L));
            this.Q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        int addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            G.get(from).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, cap, 0));
            G.get(to).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0));
            return G.get(from).size() - 1;
        }

        void enQueue(int u) {
            if (inQ.get(u) == 0 && excess.get(u) > 0) {
                Q.add(u);
                inQ.set(u, 1);
            }
        }

        void Push(int edgeIdx) {
            Edge e = edges.get(edgeIdx);
            long toPush = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, excess.get(e.from));
            if (toPush > 0 && h.get(e.from) > h.get(e.to)) {
                e.flow += toPush;
                excess.set(e.to, excess.get(e.to) + toPush);
                excess.set(e.from, excess.get(e.from) - toPush);
                edges.get(edgeIdx ^ 1).flow -= toPush;
                enQueue(e.to);
            }
        }

        void Relabel(int u) {
            count.set(h.get(u), count.get(h.get(u)) - 1);
            h.set(u, 2 * N - 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(G.get(u).get(i));
                if (e.cap > e.flow) {
                    h.set(u, Math.min(h.get(u), h.get(e.to)));
                }
            }
            h.set(u, h.get(u) + 1);
            count.set(h.get(u), count.get(h.get(u)) + 1);
        }

        void gapRelabel(int height) {
            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                if (h.get(u) >= height && h.get(u) < N) {
                    count.set(h.get(u), count.get(h.get(u)) - 1);
                    h.set(u, N);
                    count.set(h.get(u), count.get(h.get(u)) + 1);
                    enQueue(u);
                }
            }
        }

        void Discharge(int u) {
            for (int i = 0; excess.get(u) > 0 && i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Push(G.get(u).get(i));
            }
            if (excess.get(u) > 0) {
                if (h.get(u) < N && count.get(h.get(u)) < 2) {
                    gapRelabel(h.get(u));
                } else {
                    Relabel(u);
                }
            } else if (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                Q.poll();
                inQ.set(u, 0);
            }
        }

        long getFlow(int src, int snk) {
            h.set(src, N);
            inQ.set(src, 1);
            inQ.set(snk, 1);
            count.set(0, N - (count.set(N, 1) == null ? 1 : count.get(N)));
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(src).size(); i++) {
                excess.set(src, excess.get(src) + edges.get(G.get(src).get(i)).cap);
                Push(G.get(src).get(i));
            }
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                Discharge(Q.peek());
            }
            return excess.get(snk);
        }
    }

    static final int N = 25;
    static final int oo = 10007;
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static String[] s = new String[N];
    static String[] t = new String[N];
    static int n, k;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static List<int[]> source = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<int[]> sink = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] sinkid = new int[N][N];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[65][12][12][12][12];

    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                dis[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dis[x][y] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            x = cur[0];
            y = cur[1];

            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                int xx = x + dx[j];
                int yy = y + dy[j];

                if (xx < 0 || xx >= n || yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
                if (dis[xx][yy] != -1) continue;
                if (t[xx][yy] == 'Y' || t[xx][yy] == 'Z') continue;
                dis[xx][yy] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
            }
        }
    }

    static int pos(int t_val, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < t_val) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (t_val >= k) return 0;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= t_val) return 0;

        if (dp[t_val][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[t_val][x0][y0][x][y];

        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];

            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n || yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
            if (s[xx][yy] == 'Y' || s[xx][yy] == 'Z') continue;

            if (pos(t_val + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) {
                dp[t_val][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        dp[t_val][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k1 = 0; k1 < 12; k1++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
                            dp[i][j][k1][l][m] = -1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            t[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }

        int x = -1, y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (t[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs(x, y);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dis[i][j] = dis[i][j] == -1 ? oo : dis[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = s[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y' || c == '0') continue;
                source.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = t[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y' || c == '0') continue;
                sink.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        PushRelabel g = new PushRelabel(source.size() + sink.size() + 2);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            int cap = s[source.get(i)[0]].charAt(source.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            g.addEdge(0, i + 1, cap);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < sink.size(); i++) {
            int cap = t[sink.get(i)[0]].charAt(sink.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            g.addEdge(source.size() + i + 1, source.size() + sink.size() + 1, cap);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sink.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, source.get(i)[0], source.get(i)[1], sink.get(j)[0], sink.get(j)[1]) == 1) {
                    g.addEdge(i + 1, source.size() + j + 1, oo);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(g.getFlow(0, source.size() + sink.size() + 1));
    }
}
